compiled_state.title: Add schema-validation regression tests for visual-evaluator output using jsonschema + fixtures
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: Schema-validation regression test asserts JSON field presence and type constraints on a fixture
- dd-7: Unit tests written and passing

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py with:

1. Fixture files:
   - tests/plugin/fixtures/visual-evaluator/conformant-fixture.json — valid output matching all SC-1 fields with bbox_confidence="anchored", dom_xpath_visually_consistent=true, attribution_class="implementation_drift", attribution_confidence="high", scores all integers 1-5, findings array
   - tests/plugin/fixtures/visual-evaluator/malformed-fixture.json — missing dom_xpath field

2. Tests:
   - test_conformant_fixture_validates: jsonschema.validate(conformant, schema) succeeds
   - test_malformed_fixture_rejected: jsonschema.validate(malformed, schema) raises ValidationError
   - test_bbox_confidence_enum_enforced: fixture with bbox_confidence="unknown" raises ValidationError
   - test_scores_integer_range_enforced: fixture with score=6 raises ValidationError

3. Add .test-index entry: plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json:tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Conformant fixture validates against schema
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py::test_conformant_fixture_validates -v
- [ ] Malformed fixture raises ValidationError
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py::test_malformed_fixture_rejected -v
- [ ] Field-constraint tests pass (bbox_confidence enum, scores range)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py -v -k "enforced"
- [ ] .test-index entry added for schema file
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator-schema.json' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

comments.body: AC amendment: Expand to one malformed fixture per SC-1 constraint class: (1) missing required field (dom_xpath absent), (2) wrong type (scores.intent_match: 'five'), (3) enum violation (bbox_confidence: 'unknown'), (4) integer out of range (scores.whitespace_balance: 6), (5) additionalProperties leak (extra spurious_field). Parametrize test with pytest.mark.parametrize. Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py -v -k 'malformed'
